# Strong And Fit

> > Instructional fitness platform featuring kettlebell, strength, and mobility training programs from Pavel Tsatsouline, StrongFirst instructors, and elite coaches.

Strong And Fit is operated by the BJJ Fanatics team (ZR Internet LLC) and offers comprehensive video courses and ebooks covering kettlebell training, powerlifting, bodyweight exercises, and functional fitness. The platform features renowned instructors including Pavel Tsatsouline (kettlebell pioneer), Fabio Zonin, Mike Perry, Geoff Neupert, and other StrongFirst-certified trainers.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell Training
- Pavel Tsatsouline
- StrongFirst Methodology
- Functional Fitness
- Full-Body Workouts
- Strength Training Programs
- Bodyweight Training
- Powerlifting
- Mobility & Injury Prevention
- TACFIT
- Russian Kettlebell Challenge (RKC)
- Beginner to Advanced Progressions
- 12-Week Programs
- Muscle Building
- Video Courses

- [Strong And Fit](https://strongandfit.com): Homepage: instructional videos from Pavel Tsatsouline & top trainers

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://strongandfit.com/pages/frequently-asked-questions): FAQ: refunds, course access, account management & digital downloads

## Kettlebell Training Programs

- [KB Essentials: Instructional Guide to Kettlebell Training | Mike Perry](https://strongandfit.com/products/kb-essentials-instructional-guide-to-kettlebell-training-by-mike-perry): Complete kettlebell training guide by Mike Perry for all levels
- [Easy Muscle by Geoff Neupert](https://strongandfit.com/products/easy-muscle-by-geoff-neupert): 12-week kettlebell muscle-building program for men over 40
- [Progressive Swap by Fabio Zonin](https://strongandfit.com/products/progressive-swap-by-fabio-zonin): 15-week strength program by StrongFirst instructor Fabio Zonin
- [Built Strong Minimalist by Fabio Zonin](https://strongandfit.com/products/built-strong-minimalist-by-fabio-zonin): Minimalist strength training with kettlebells by Fabio Zonin
- [Built Strong Maximum BTS4 and BTS6 by Fabio Zonin](https://strongandfit.com/products/built-strong-maximum-bts4-and-bts6-by-fabio-zonin): 12-week hypertrophy program by StrongFirst's Fabio Zonin

## Strength & Specialized Training

- [Raw Strength by John Gaglione](https://strongandfit.com/products/raw-strength-by-john-gaglione): 12-week powerlifting program by John Gaglione with ebook
- [Simplified Strength Training E-Book by Alex Sterner & Alex Bryce](https://strongandfit.com/products/simplified-strength-training-templates-e-book-by-alex-sterner-alex-bryce): Combat sports strength ebook with 4-day routine by Sterner & Bryce
- [Band Based Mobility Program by Aaron Alexander](https://strongandfit.com/products/tuning-up-the-band-by-aaron-alexandre): Resistance band mobility course by Aaron Alexander for all levels
- [Intu-Flow 101 by TACFIT](https://strongandfit.com/products/intu-flow-101-by-tacfit): TACFIT mobility course for injury prevention & joint health
- [Crawl More Become More by Louka Kurcer](https://strongandfit.com/products/crawl-more-become-more-by-louka-kurcer): 8-week crawling exercise ebook by Louka Kurcer for coordination

## Kettlebell Education & Guides

- [News](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news): Blog index: kettlebell exercises, workouts & fitness guides
- [Exploring the Essence of Kettlebells: What Are They and Why Do They Matter?](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/what-is-a-kettlebell): Kettlebell basics: history, benefits & Pavel Tsatsouline's influence
- [Mastering the Russian Kettlebell Challenge: Strength, Certification, and Transformation](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/russian-kettlebell-challenge): RKC certification program by Pavel Tsatsouline explained
- [A Deep Dive into Functional Kettlebell Exercises: Unleashing Functional Power](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/functional-kettlebell-exercises): Functional kettlebell movements: Turkish get-ups, windmills & more
- [Elevating Your Cardio with Kettlebell Workouts: A Comprehensive Guide](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/kettlebell-cardio-workouts): Kettlebell cardio guide: swings, snatches & cardiovascular fitness
- [How Many Kettlebells Do I Need? Finding the Right Balance for Your Workouts](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/how-many-kettlebells-do-i-need): Kettlebell buying guide: choosing weights for your fitness level
- [How Long Should a Kettlebell Workout Be](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/how-long-should-a-kettlebell-workout-be): Guide to optimal kettlebell workout duration for fitness goals

- [5 Minute Kettlebell Workout](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/5-minute-kettlebell-workout): Quick kettlebell routine for busy schedules with high intensity
- [Unlocking Pectoral Power with the Kettlebell Fly: A Comprehensive Guide](https://strongandfit.com/blogs/news/kettlebell-fly): Kettlebell fly technique for chest training with form guidance
